title: Question 7
passage:
How often does the community choir rehearse?
A. At seven in the evening. B. Every other Tuesday. C. In the room above the bakery.
passageZh:
這個社區合唱團多久排練一次？
A. 晚上七點。 B. 每隔一週的星期二。 C. 在麵包店樓上的房間。
